5 May 2008

## Circular to Fund Management Companies of SFC-authorized Funds

## Proposal to Exempt Collective Investment Schemes from Disclosure of Interests Requirements

The  Commission  has  issued  a  consultation  paper  today  to  seek  comments  from  the public in respect of the proposal to exempt open-ended collective investment schemes authorized by the Commission taking the form of mutual fund companies or otherwise in corporate form and which are listed on The Stock Exchange of Hong Kong Limited from  the  disclosure  of  interests  requirements  under  Part  XV  of  the  Securities  and Futures Ordinance.

The consultation paper is available on our website at www.sfc.hk.  Your comments are most welcomed.

If you wish to clarify any aspects of the consultation paper, please contact your team supervisor  of  the  Investment  Products  Department  who  is  responsible  for  overseeing your schemes.

Investment Products Department Securities and Futures Commission

## SECURITIES AND FUTURES COMMISSION
